passages.note: Heaton voted Yea on HJR 3 3rd reading in the Indiana House.
Bill details page lists Heaton as a co-author of HJR 3.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

passages.provision_quote: Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: Engrossed HJR 3 operative text, the provision Heaton co-authored and voted for.

rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its single-subject 3rd reading passage (57-40). The operative text, "Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana," matches rung 5, "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman."
